spongebert.name: SpongeBert
spongebert.bio: An endlessly cheerful fry cook who lives in a pineapple and loves his job more than anything in the ocean.
spongebert.catchphrase: I'm ready! I'm ready! I'm ready!

pat.name: Pat Starfish
pat.bio: SpongeBert's best friend. Lives under a rock. Thinks very hard about things, occasionally.

squidwerd.name: Squidwerd
squidwerd.bio: A grumpy cashier and self-declared artistic genius who just wants some peace and quiet for his clarinet.

mr_crabs.name: Mr. Crabs
mr_crabs.bio: Owner of the Krusty Crab. A retired sea captain whose one true love is money. Argh!

sandy.name: Sandy Acorn
sandy.bio: A karate-chopping scientist squirrel from Texas who lives under the sea in an air-filled dome.

arnald.name: Arnald
arnald.bio: A kind, optimistic fourth-grader with a football-shaped head who lives with his grandparents at a boarding house. Always tries to help.

helga.name: Helga Potaki
helga.bio: The toughest kid in the fourth grade, with one eyebrow and a big pink bow. Secretly writes love poems about Arnald.

gerold.name: Gerold
gerold.bio: Arnald's cool, level-headed best friend. Keeper of the neighborhood's urban legends. Tall hair, taller confidence.

grandpa.name: Grandpa Phil
grandpa.bio: Arnald's grandpa. Runs the Sunset Arms boarding house, tells tall tales from the old days, and calls Arnald "Shortman".

phoebee.name: Phoebee
phoebee.bio: Helga's brilliant, loyal best friend. Top of the class, fluent in facts, and always ready with a plan.

plankton.name: Plankton
plankton.bio: A tiny evil genius who owns the Chum Bucket and wants the secret patty formula more than anything.
plankton.catchphrase: I'll get that formula if it's the last thing I do!

karen.name: Karen
karen.bio: Plankton's computer wife. Smarter than him, and she knows it.
karen.catchphrase: Plankton, that plan has a ninety-nine percent chance of failure.

mrs_puff.name: Mrs. Puff
mrs_puff.bio: The very patient boating teacher. Puffs up when she's frightened, which is often.

pearl.name: Pearl
pearl.bio: Mr. Crabs' teenage whale daughter. Loves the mall, hates being embarrassed.

gary.name: Gary
gary.bio: SpongeBert's pet snail. Says only 'meow' but understands everything.

larry.name: Larry the Lobster
larry.bio: Bikini Bottom's lifeguard and gym enthusiast. Never skips claw day.

grandma.name: Grandma Pookie
grandma.bio: Arnald's wildly adventurous grandma. Karate expert, explorer, and occasional pirate.

harold.name: Harold
harold.bio: The biggest kid in the fourth grade. Loves food, hates being teased.

stinky.name: Stinky
stinky.bio: Tall, slow-talking and kind. Lemon pudding is his favorite thing in the world.
stinky.catchphrase: Well, I reckon that's mighty fine.

sid.name: Sid
sid.bio: Arnald's jumpy friend who believes every scary story he hears.
sid.catchphrase: Oh man, this is bad! This is really bad!

rhonda.name: Rhonda
rhonda.bio: The most fashionable girl at P.S. 118. Has opinions about everyone's outfits.

big_bob.name: Big Bob
big_bob.bio: Helga's loud dad and the Beeper King of Hillwood.

dug.name: Dug Funnie
dug.bio: A thoughtful kid who writes everything in his journal and imagines himself as a superhero.

skeetor.name: Skeetor
skeetor.bio: Dug's best friend. Blue, goofy and the world's best honker.

patty.name: Patty Mayonaise
patty.bio: Sporty, smart and kind. Dug has had a crush on her since forever.

rodger.name: Rodger Klotz
rodger.bio: The local bully with a leather jacket and a green complexion.

porkchop.name: Porkchop
porkchop.bio: Dug's very smart dog. Walks on two legs when nobody's looking.

judie.name: Judie Funnie
judie.bio: Dug's older sister. A dramatic artist who quotes Shakespeare at breakfast.
judie.catchphrase: Doug, you are SUCH a philistine.

beebe.name: Beebe Bluff
beebe.bio: Patty's best friend. Her family owns most of Bluffington.
beebe.catchphrase: Daddy will just buy another one.

mr_dink.name: Mr. Dink
mr_dink.bio: The Funnies' neighbor. Buys every gadget ever made.

connie.name: Connie Benge
connie.bio: A kind, quiet classmate who'd like to be noticed more.

chalky.name: Chalky Studebaker
chalky.bio: Straight-A student, star athlete, and annoyingly nice about it.

mr_bone.name: Mr. Bone
mr_bone.bio: The vice principal. Runs a very, very tight ship.

tommi.name: Tommi Pickles
tommi.bio: A brave one-year-old with a toy screwdriver who can open any playpen.
tommi.catchphrase: A baby's gotta do what a baby's gotta do!

chuckey.name: Chuckey Finster
chuckey.bio: Tommi's best friend. Scared of almost everything, brave when it counts.
chuckey.catchphrase: I don't think this is such a good idea!

angelika.name: Angelika Pickles
angelika.bio: Tommi's bossy three-year-old cousin. Rules the playpen with an iron fist.

phill.name: Phill DeVille
phill.bio: One of the twins. Loves worms, mud and arguing with his sister.

lill.name: Lill DeVille
lill.bio: The other twin. Loves worms just as much, thank you very much.

stew.name: Stew Pickles
stew.bio: Tommi's dad. Toy inventor. Most of his toys explode.
stew.catchphrase: This one's gonna be a winner!

didee.name: Didee Pickles
didee.bio: Tommi's mom. Has read every baby book ever written.

grandpa_lew.name: Grandpa Lew
grandpa_lew.bio: Tommi's grandpa. Supposed to be babysitting. Usually napping.

spyke.name: Spyke
spyke.bio: The Pickles' big scruffy dog. The babies' noble steed.

suzie.name: Suzie Carmichael
suzie.bio: The kid across the street. Smart, brave, and Angelika's rival.

jessee.name: Jessee
jessee.bio: Team Rokket's dramatic, short-tempered leader of schemes.

jaymes.name: Jaymes
jaymes.bio: Team Rokket's softhearted schemer. Loves bottle caps and dramatic poses.

meowt.name: Meowt
meowt.bio: A cat who taught himself to talk and walk. The brains (and the mouth) of the team.

wobbafett.name: Wobbafett
wobbafett.bio: A big blue blob who only ever says its own name, very enthusiastically.

boss.name: The Boss
boss.bio: Team Rokket's stern boss. Disappointed. Always disappointed.

ashe.name: Ashe Ketchum
ashe.bio: A ten-year-old trainer who wants to be the very best. Like no one ever was.

pikachew.name: Pikachew
pikachew.bio: Ashe's electric mouse. Refuses to ride in a ball.

mistee.name: Mistee
mistee.bio: A water-monster trainer with a short temper and a big mallet.

brok.name: Brok
brok.bio: A rock-type trainer and great cook. Falls in love in every town.

nurse_joi.name: Nurse Joi
nurse_joi.bio: Runs the Monster Clinic. Has a dozen cousins who look exactly like her.
nurse_joi.catchphrase: We hope to see you again!

officer_jenni.name: Officer Jenni
officer_jenni.bio: Town police. Has a dozen cousins who look exactly like her too.

gokku.name: Gokku
gokku.bio: A cheerful Saiyan martial artist who's always hungry and always training.

vegitta.name: Vegitta
vegitta.bio: The proud prince of all Saiyans. Gokku's rival, whether Gokku likes it or not.
vegitta.catchphrase: I am the prince of all Saiyans!

gohann.name: Gohann
gohann.bio: Gokku's son. Would rather be studying, but secretly the strongest of them all.

picollo.name: Picollo
picollo.bio: A grumpy green warrior from Planet Nameck. Gohann's mentor and secret softie.

krillen.name: Krillen
krillen.bio: Gokku's best friend. Bald, brave and usually the first to get flattened.

bulmah.name: Bulmah
bulmah.bio: A genius inventor from Capsool Corp. Builds everything the heroes need.
bulmah.catchphrase: Do I have to do everything myself?

master_roshee.name: Master Roshee
master_roshee.bio: The old Turtle Hermit who trained Gokku. Mostly naps and reads magazines now.

freeza.name: Freeza
freeza.bio: A tiny, terribly polite tyrant who wants to rule the universe.

sel.name: Cel
sel.bio: A perfect bio-android who loves holding tournaments about himself.

trunkz.name: Trunkz
trunkz.bio: Vegitta and Bulmah's son from a gloomy future. Carries a very cool sword.

chee_chee.name: Chee-Chee
chee_chee.bio: Gokku's wife. Wants Gohann to study and Gokku to get a job. Has a frying pan.

erren.name: Erren Jaeger
erren.bio: A hot-headed Scout who swore to wipe out every last Titan.

mikasah.name: Mikasah Ackerman
mikasah.bio: Erren's quiet, unstoppable friend. Never takes off her red scarf.

armen.name: Armen Arlert
armen.bio: The team's brilliant planner. Dreams of seeing the ocean.

levee.name: Captain Levee
levee.bio: Humanity's strongest soldier. Also humanity's fussiest cleaner.

hanjee.name: Hanjee Zoe
hanjee.bio: A scientist who thinks Titans are the most fascinating things ever.

jeen.name: Jeen Kirstein
jeen.bio: A cocky Scout who'd much rather have a nice safe job.

sascha.name: Sascha Braus
sascha.bio: A sharpshooter with a bottomless appetite. Will steal your potato.

konny.name: Konny Springer
konny.bio: A loud, cheerful Scout who isn't always sure what's going on.

rayner.name: Rayner
rayner.bio: A big, dependable Scout everybody trusts. Has a lot on his mind.

irwin.name: Commander Irwin
irwin.bio: The Scouts' fearless commander. Gives very rousing speeches.

grinning_titan.name: Grinning Titan
grinning_titan.bio: A huge, smiling Titan. Nobody knows what it's thinking. Probably lunch.

walt.name: Walt Whyte
walt.bio: A mild-mannered chemistry teacher who makes the purest blue rock candy in the whole Southwest.

pinkman.name: Jessie Pinkmann
pinkman.bio: Walt's former student and candy-making partner. Says 'yo' a lot.

skylar.name: Skylar Whyte
skylar.bio: Walt's wife. Suspects something. Keeps the family's books.

hank.name: Hank Schraeder
hank.bio: Walt's brother-in-law. A loud, lovable agent who collects minerals.

maree.name: Maree Schraeder
maree.bio: Hank's wife. Everything she owns is purple.

flynn.name: Flynn
flynn.bio: Walt's son. Loves breakfast more than anything in the world.

saul.name: Saul Goodmann
saul.bio: A fast-talking lawyer with loud suits and louder TV ads.

gus.name: Gus Frinng
gus.bio: The calm, extremely polite owner of Los Pollitos Hermanos chicken.

mike.name: Mike Ermantrout
mike.bio: A tired fixer who's seen it all. Fond of half measures. Not fond of Jessie.

badgur.name: Badgur
badgur.bio: Jessie's friend. Has big ideas for a space movie.

skinnee_pete.name: Skinnee Pete
skinnee_pete.bio: Jessie's other friend. Secretly a great piano player.

mareo.name: Mareo
mareo.bio: A plumber who jumps on things. Saves the princess most weekends.

luiggi.name: Luiggi
luiggi.bio: Mareo's taller brother. Brave, mostly. Scared of ghosts, definitely.

peech.name: Princess Peech
peech.bio: Ruler of the Mushroom Kingdom. Gets kidnapped a lot. Bakes a great cake.

daizy.name: Princess Daizy
daizy.bio: A sporty princess from a neighboring kingdom. Very loud. Very fun.

waryo.name: Waryo
waryo.bio: Mareo's greedy rival. Loves gold and garlic.

toadd.name: Toadd
toadd.bio: A loyal mushroom retainer who tells everyone the princess is in another castle.
toadd.catchphrase: The princess is in another castle!

bowzer.name: Bowzer
bowzer.bio: King of the Koopas. Wants the princess and the kingdom. Gets neither.

yoshee.name: Yoshee
yoshee.bio: A friendly green dinosaur who'll eat anything with his long tongue.

donkee_kongg.name: Donkee Kongg
donkee_kongg.bio: A big banana-loving ape in a red tie.

gumba.name: Gumba
gumba.bio: A grumpy walking mushroom. Gets stepped on for a living.

kooper.name: Kooper Troopa
kooper.bio: A turtle soldier in Bowzer's army. Secretly just wants a vacation.

samuss.name: Samuss Aran
samuss.bio: A legendary bounty hunter in a power suit. A woman of very few words.

dark_samuss.name: Dark Samuss
dark_samuss.bio: A shadowy copy of Samuss made of strange blue energy.

ridlee.name: Ridlee
ridlee.bio: A space-pirate dragon who never, ever stays defeated.

krayd.name: Krayd
krayd.bio: An enormous reptile who fires the spikes off his own belly.

mother_brane.name: Mother Brane
mother_brane.bio: The giant brain in a jar who runs the space pirates.

baby_metroyd.name: Baby Metroyd
baby_metroyd.bio: A floating jellyfish creature that thinks Samuss is its mom.

adam.name: Adam Malkovitch
adam.bio: Samuss's old commanding officer. Very good at saying 'any objections?'

choso_elder.name: Choso Elder
choso_elder.bio: A wise, ancient bird-person who raised Samuss.

space_pirate.name: Space Pirate
space_pirate.bio: A clawed space pirate grunt. Mostly guards doors.

etecoon.name: Etecoon
etecoon.bio: A tiny green wall-jumping critter. Very good at showing you the way.

dachoora.name: Dachoora
dachoora.bio: A fast ostrich-like bird. Can run faster than the speed of plot.

kirbie.name: Kirbie
kirbie.bio: A round pink hero from Dream Land. Inhales anything. Only ever says 'Poyo!'

dedeedee.name: King Dedeedee
dedeedee.bio: The greedy, self-proclaimed king of Dream Land. Loves food almost as much as Kirbie does.

meta_nite.name: Meta Nite
meta_nite.bio: A masked swordsman of honor. Always appears dramatically.

waddle_dii.name: Waddle Dii
waddle_dii.bio: One of the king's many round helpers. Friendly and easily flattened.

bandana_dii.name: Bandana Dii
bandana_dii.bio: The bravest Waddle Dii, with a blue bandana and a spear.

waddle_doo.name: Waddle Doo
waddle_doo.bio: A one-eyed helper who zaps things with his eye beam.

magalor.name: Magalor
magalor.bio: A hooded traveler from another dimension. Very charming. Possibly up to something.

marks.name: Marks
marks.bio: A giggling jester who wants to rule Pop Star. Never trust that grin.

adelaine.name: Adelaine
adelaine.bio: A traveling painter whose drawings come to life.

ribbonn.name: Ribbonn
ribbonn.bio: A tiny fairy from Ripple Star with a big red bow.

whispee_woods.name: Whispee Woods
whispee_woods.bio: A grumpy old tree who drops apples on people he doesn't like.

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.bio: A fancy voice from somewhere above the waves.
